context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 2 fully green. Details of what was actually verified in the preview UI (screenshots retained in .screenshots): (1) /tokens with a logged-in admin lands on /settings?tab=plans. (2) Admin wallet card [data-testid=plans-wallet-remaining] shows '∞ Unlimited' matching GET /usage/me is_unlimited=true. (3) Fresh free-tier user's wallet shows '1,000', identical to GET /usage/me remaining=1000 for the same token — regression parity between Profile-tab and Plans-tab wallets is implicit since both now read /usage/me. (4) Usage history card [data-testid=settings-usage-history] on admin shows rows in format 'YYYY-MM-DD / N tokens / N activities' with NO $ / provider / model text; on the brand-new free user shows literal 'No activity in the last 30 days.'. (5) Free user has NO 'Team' item in the settings nav; direct-URL /settings?tab=team renders [data-testid=team-panel-upgrade-required] with copy 'Team management is a Team-plan feature.' — NOT team-panel-no-access. (6) POST /team/invite with the free user's Bearer token → 403 {"detail":"Team management is a Team-plan feature. Upgrade to invite teammates."}. (7) GET /usage/me/history with no Authorization → 401 'Authorization header missing'. (8) Admin /settings?tab=team still renders the invite form (no upgrade card). Homepage testimonials/counter intentionally left original per founder — not flagged. Note for future runs: signup/login via urllib from this container hits Cloudflare 1010; use page.evaluate(fetch...) inside the browser context (which has cf_clearance) instead.
